definition_en: Needed or necessary for a particular purpose.
example_en: Attendance is required for all students during exams.
example_uz: Imtihonlar davomida barcha talabalar uchun qatnashish talab qilinadi.

definition_en: Not staying the same or not in agreement with other facts.
example_en: Her answers were inconsistent with what she said earlier.
example_uz: Uning javoblari avval aytganlariga izchil emas edi.

definition_en: A lack of agreement or steadiness between things.
example_en: The report contained several inconsistencies.
example_uz: Hisobotda bir nechta izchilsizliklar bor edi.

definition_en: Happening again repeatedly or periodically.
example_en: She suffers from recurrent headaches every winter.
example_uz: U har qishda takrorlanuvchi bosh og'rig'idan aziyat chekadi.

definition_en: Happening or appearing repeatedly.
example_en: This is a recurring theme in the author's novels.
example_uz: Bu muallif romanlarida takrorlanadigan mavzu.

definition_en: To happen again after happening before.
example_en: Doctors want to prevent the illness from reoccurring.
example_uz: Shifokorlar kasallikning qayta yuz berishining oldini olishni xohlashadi.

definition_en: Used to say that something is likely to be true.
example_en: Presumably, the meeting was cancelled because of the storm.
example_uz: Ehtimol, yig'ilish bo'ron sababli bekor qilingan.

definition_en: Something believed to be true without proof.
example_en: There is a legal presumption of innocence.
example_uz: Aybsizlik haqida huquqiy taxmin mavjud.

definition_en: Too confident in a way that is rude or disrespectful.
example_en: It would be presumptuous of me to speak on her behalf.
example_uz: Uning nomidan gapirishim haddan tashqari o'ziga ishonganlik bo'lardi.

definition_en: Serving to prove something and remove all doubt.
example_en: The test results were conclusive evidence of the theory.
example_uz: Test natijalari nazariyaning yakuniy dalili edi.

definition_en: Not leading to a clear result or decision.
example_en: The investigation remained inconclusive after months of work.
example_uz: Oylab davom etgan ishdan keyin ham tergov noaniq qoldi.

definition_en: Coming at the end of something, especially a speech or text.
example_en: The concluding paragraph summarizes the main points.
example_uz: Yakunlovchi paragraf asosiy fikrlarni jamlaydi.

definition_en: Having great influence on someone or something.
example_en: She is one of the most influential leaders in the country.
example_uz: U mamlakatdagi eng ta'sirli yetakchilardan biri.

definition_en: Too small or unimportant to be worth considering.
example_en: The difference in price was insignificant.
example_uz: Narxdagi farq ahamiyatsiz edi.

definition_en: Widely accepted, respected, or in existence for a long time.
example_en: It's an established company with a strong reputation.
example_uz: Bu mustahkam obro'ga ega o'rnashgan kompaniya.

definition_en: To set up or create something again after it stopped.
example_en: The two countries agreed to reestablish diplomatic relations.
example_uz: Ikki davlat diplomatik aloqalarni qayta tiklashga rozi bo'lishdi.

definition_en: Not controlled by official rules.
example_en: The unregulated market led to unfair prices.
example_uz: Tartibga solinmagan bozor adolatsiz narxlarga olib keldi.

definition_en: To remove government control from an industry.
example_en: The government decided to deregulate the airline industry.
example_uz: Hukumat aviakompaniyalar sohasini tartibga solishni bekor qilishga qaror qildi.

definition_en: Not limited or controlled.
example_en: Members get unrestricted access to the gym.
example_uz: A'zolar sport zaliga cheklanmagan kirish huquqiga ega.

definition_en: Limiting someone's freedom or actions.
example_en: The new rules were seen as too restrictive.
example_uz: Yangi qoidalar juda cheklovchi deb qaraldi.

definition_en: Not able to continue at the same level or rate.
example_en: This rate of deforestation is completely unsustainable.
example_uz: O'rmonlarni kesishning bu darajasi butunlay barqaror emas.

definition_en: Continuing for a long time without stopping.
example_en: The economy showed sustained growth for five years.
example_uz: Iqtisodiyot besh yil davomida barqaror o'sishni ko'rsatdi.

definition_en: To grow again or come back to a healthy state.
example_en: Human skin cells regenerate naturally over time.
example_uz: Inson teri hujayralari vaqt o'tishi bilan tabiiy ravishda qayta tiklanadi.

definition_en: The process of growing or being restored again.
example_en: Urban regeneration transformed the old factory district.
example_uz: Shahar qayta tiklanishi eski zavod hududini o'zgartirdi.

definition_en: To break into small pieces or fall apart.
example_en: The old newspaper began to disintegrate when touched.
example_uz: Eski gazeta qo'l tekkanda parchalana boshladi.

definition_en: The process of breaking into small parts.
example_en: The disintegration of the empire took several decades.
example_uz: Imperiyaning parchalanishi bir necha o'n yillikni oldi.

definition_en: Able to be recognized as different.
example_en: The two twins are barely distinguishable from each other.
example_uz: Ikki egizak bir-biridan deyarli farqlanmaydi.

definition_en: Impossible to tell apart from something else.
example_en: From a distance, the copy was indistinguishable from the original.
example_uz: Uzoqdan nusxa asl nusxadan farqlanmas edi.

definition_en: Successful and respected, especially in a profession.
example_en: She had a long and distinguished career in medicine.
example_uz: U tibbiyotda uzoq va taniqli martaba qurdi.

definition_en: Relating to explaining the meaning of something.
example_en: The museum offers an interpretive tour of the ruins.
example_uz: Muzey xarobalarning talqin qiluvchi sayohatini taklif qiladi.

definition_en: To understand something incorrectly.
example_en: Don't misinterpret my silence as agreement.
example_uz: Sukutimni rozilik deb noto'g'ri talqin qilmang.

definition_en: An incorrect understanding of something.
example_en: The confusion arose from a simple misinterpretation.
example_uz: Chalkashlik oddiy noto'g'ri talqindan kelib chiqqan.

definition_en: Able to change easily to suit new conditions.
example_en: Good employees are flexible and adaptable to change.
example_uz: Yaxshi xodimlar moslashuvchan va o'zgarishlarga tez ko'nikadigan bo'ladi.

definition_en: One of the parts that forms a whole thing.
example_en: Water is a constituent of almost every living cell.
example_uz: Suv deyarli har bir tirik hujayraning tarkibiy qismidir.

definition_en: Able to be shown clearly to be true.
example_en: The new method had a demonstrable effect on test scores.
example_uz: Yangi usul test natijalariga isbotlanadigan ta'sir ko'rsatdi.

definition_en: Combined into a single, connected system.
example_en: The company uses an integrated software system.
example_uz: Kompaniya birlashtirilgan dasturiy ta'minot tizimidan foydalanadi.

definition_en: Causing a major and lasting positive change.
example_en: Education can have a transformative effect on communities.
example_uz: Ta'lim jamiyatlarga o'zgartiruvchi ta'sir ko'rsatishi mumkin.

definition_en: Able to produce or generate something, especially new ideas or content.
example_en: Generative technology can now write essays and create images.
example_uz: Yaratuvchi texnologiya endi insho yozishi va tasvirlar yaratishi mumkin.

definition_en: Not allowed by a country's constitution.
example_en: The court ruled the new law was unconstitutional.
example_uz: Sud yangi qonunni konstitutsiyaga zid deb topdi.
